newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BT raises stakes in Australian miners.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BT raises stakes in Australian miners.

text.p: Fund manager Bankers Trust Australia said on Thursday it has raised its stakes in gold miner Newscrest Mining Ltd and gold and base metals miner MIM Holdings Ltd.
Bankers Trust said in a shareholders' notice to the Australian Stock Exchange that it had raised its Newscrest stake to 9.76 percent from 8.43 percent and now holds 23.11 million Newscrest shares.
It said it has increased its holding in MIM above the five percent substantial shareholder level and now holds 5.28 percent of MIM. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
